description.ja: “次世代のファーストガンプラ”第二弾に「ストライクガンダム」が登場！
description.en: "Strike Gundam " is now available in the second installment of " Next Generation's First Gunpla"!

description.ja: • 装備にビームライフル、シールドが付属。
description.en: • Beam rifle and Seal are included as equipment.

description.ja: • 大胆かつ秀逸なパーツ分割。組み立てるだけで色分けを再現。塗装はもちろんシール貼りも不要。
description.en: • Bold and excellent parts division. Reproduce color coding just by assembly. No painting or sealing required.

description.ja: • 部位ごとにパーツがまとまっていて、わかりやすいランナー配置。ニッパーを使わず手でパチパチと簡単に外せるタッチゲート仕様。
description.en: • Easy-to-understand runner layout with parts grouped by area. Touch gate design that can be easily removed by hand without using nippers.

description.ja: • 胴体をはじめ、脚部、腕部の可動箇所は大きな可動範囲を確保。大胆なアクションポーズに対応可能。
description.en: • The torso, legs, and arms have a wide range of motion. Can accommodate bold action poses.

description.ja: • カメラアイの黒い輪郭は、パーツ同士のクリアランスにできる影で表現。
description.en: • The black outline of the camera eye is expressed by the shadow created by the clearance between parts.
